items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: I saw them live in Cleveland when I was 18 years old... we saw Cannonball and Nancy and loved every minute of it.

ctx.x: I love the record too. She’s got these cool arrangements with Cannonball and Nat.

Oh yeah. I saw them live in Cleveland when I was 18 years old and there was a great club called Leo’s Casino, and you had to put leis around your neck because you couldn’t drink at 18, and you had these Hawaiian leis on your neck and my future wife and I were sitting there, and we saw Cannonball and Nancy and loved every minute of it.
Oh you saw the two of them together.
